# Bay City Blinds

> Bay City Blinds is a local, family-owned mobile blinds, shutters, curtains and awnings business serving Geelong, the Bellarine Peninsula, the Surf Coast and Melbourne's west. Owner-operated by Jackson since 2020. Every job includes a free, no-obligation in-home measure & quote — Jackson brings the mobile showroom to the customer's home rather than requiring a showroom visit. Products are Australian made, and every job is locally manufactured, serviced and installed in Geelong.

## Services

- [Free Measure & Quote](https://baycityblinds.com.au/free-measure-quote): book a free, no-obligation in-home measure and quote.
- [Service & Repairs](https://baycityblinds.com.au/service-and-repairs): blind, shutter, curtain and awning repairs and servicing, no call-out fee for the initial inspection, obligation-free quotes.
- [Indoor Blinds & Shutters](https://baycityblinds.com.au/indoor): roller blinds, honeycomb blinds, Venetian blinds, plantation shutters, blockout blinds, pelmet boxes, curtains.
- [Outdoor](https://baycityblinds.com.au/outdoor): Zipscreen outdoor blinds, roller shutters, traditional awnings, folding arm awnings.
- [Security](https://baycityblinds.com.au/security): security doors and security shutters, with three screen tiers from entry-level (Restrict-A-View, 2mm) to premium, Crimsafe-style (Screenguard, 9mm, 3-point locking).
- [Motorised](https://baycityblinds.com.au/motorised): solar, battery and hard-wired motorisation, compatible with Google Home and other smart home platforms. Brands installed: Linx, Somfy, Automate, Alpha.

## Key pages

- [About Jackson](https://baycityblinds.com.au/about)
